FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Find answers to your questions here.
FAQ.a1: Yes, all core features of Zypio Convert are 100% free. No registration is required and there are no hidden fees.
FAQ.q2: Are my downloaded files stored on the server?
FAQ.a2: No. For your security and copyright (DMCA) compliance, processed files are permanently deleted from our servers within 1 hour.
FAQ.a3: We support MP4 (1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p) for video, and MP3 (320kbps, 128kbps) for audio.
FAQ.q4: Can I download TikTok videos without watermark?
FAQ.a4: Yes, when you paste a TikTok link, our system automatically provides the video without any watermark (logo).
FAQ.q5: Does it work on mobile devices (iOS/Android)?
FAQ.a5: Zypio Convert is completely web-based. It works flawlessly on all smartphones and tablets without needing to install any app.
